nodes.label: Acronym and Abbreviation Glossary for Schizophrenia Guideline
nodes.rationale: Standardizes 70+ abbreviations spanning rating scales, regulators, consortia, statistics, and drug classes so statements and tables resolve symbols consistently.

nodes.label: VMAT2 Vesicular Monoamine Transporter 2 Definition
nodes.rationale: Target of valbenazine, deutetrabenazine, and tetrabenazine for tardive syndromes; distinct from CYP enzymes and receptor-affinity symbols used in antipsychotic tables.

nodes.label: LAI Long-Acting Injectable Definition
nodes.rationale: Designates depot formulations that assure continuous delivery; key to adherence-related recommendations across maintenance and injectable statements.
